component.name: VapourBox
component.summary: Deinterlace, restore and convert video with VapourSynth and QTGMC

description.p: VapourBox is a desktop app for archiving and converting video: tape captures, camcorder footage, film scans, DVDs, and the digital files you already have. It runs VapourSynth, QTGMC and FFmpeg, the tools the video restoration community already uses, without requiring you to write a script.

ul.li: Converts DV, AVCHD, MPEG-2, MXF and ordinary MP4, MKV, AVI and MOV files, DVD folders and discs
Deinterlaces with QTGMC and reverses telecine, after detecting how the source is stored
Optional cleanup filters for tape noise, colour bleed, film dust and scratches, ghosting and more
Presets named after the source: VHS, DV camcorder tape, DVD and broadcast, anime, 8mm and Super 8 film
A side-by-side preview of the source and the processed result, and a queue for batches
Encodes to H.264, HEVC, ProRes and lossless formats, with hardware encoders where available

description.p: The AppImage includes the processing components, so it works without a network connection. It needs glibc 2.39 or newer (Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 13).

screenshot.caption: An interlaced capture with the original and the deinterlaced result side by side
